stories.text: Ada secretly mended Ben’s winter coat and left it folded by his door
Leela reads letters aloud for neighbours who are too embarrassed to ask
Edda stayed late to give a tired neighbour a free crossing home
Vesa carried warm soup to Nell and stayed until her fever eased
Greta repaid an old debt to Pim even though he had forgotten it
Dara spent the afternoon finding Mab’s lost basket instead of taking a break
Suri replaced every chipped school bowl without putting her name on the gift
Nell sat beside Sol all night so Greta could finally get some sleep
